content.thinking:
The 'deep' test line has a syntax issue — the raw bytes construction: `b'{"version":3,"cases":[]}'[:-1] + b'"x":' + ...` — this creates `{"version":3,"cases":[` + `"x":` + 70 `[` + 70 `]` + `}` which is malformed JSON anyway (an array with a key). Let me build a proper deep-nesting test: `{"version":3,"cases":[[[[...]]]]}` with 70 levels.

Let me fix that line.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='/workspace/dev/invalid_tests.py'
src=open(path).read()
bad=[l for l in src.split('\n') if l.startswith("T('deep'")][0]
good = "T('deep', b'{\"version\":3,\"cases\":' + b'[' * 70 + b']' * 70 + b'}')"
src=src.replace(bad, good)
open(path,'w').write(src)
print(good)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && timeout 900 python3 dev/invalid_tests.py
